6.185 rsWrongNumberOfParameters
rsWrongNumberOfParameters is a critical error that will occur when an expression uses one of the
aggregate functions with an incorrect number of parameters. For example, this error will occur when a
TextRun.Value element contains an expression "=Sum()".
